description:
⚡ X3 Foldable Electric Bike – The Ultimate Portable Commuter

Tired of lugging around heavy e-bikes? Meet the X3 Electric Bike—your ultra-light, compact, and effortlessly portable ride designed for daily life on the move. Featuring our signature "Open & Close" quick-fold system, you can collapse and store it in seconds. Whether you're hopping on a train, throwing it in the trunk, or storing it under your desk, the X3 fits right into your lifestyle.

Why You’ll Love It

1-Second Quick Fold: Our unique "open & close" design makes storage an absolute breeze.

Removable Smart
Battery: Pop the battery out and charge it anywhere—at your desk, in a coffee shop, or at home. No need to bring the whole bike inside.

Zippy & Powerful: Cruise smoothly at 15.5 mph powered by a reliable 250W brushless motor.

Built for the Distance: Go further with a range of up to 20 miles per charge on a premium 36V Lithium Battery.

Ultra-Compact: Lightweight, easy to carry, and fits into tight spaces effortlessly.

Product Specifications

X3 Electric Bike has a unique "open and close" option - light and easy to carry! The perfect ride for short commutes / 15.5 mph up to almost 20 miles / 250 Brushless Motor with 36V Lithium Battery
